explication: Ticket office, bus, inspection, station or management: choose your work, then login wit your number.

pin.aide: Na your account PIN. Nobody for AfriMove go ever ask you for am.

motDePasse.aide: One code go still reach you by SMS to show say na you.

code.libelle: Code wey you receive by SMS
code.aide: We don send one 6-digit code. E go work for {{minutes}} minutes.

enrolement.explication: Your owner or supervisor go give you one enrollment code. E dey work only one time.
enrolement.necessaire: Dis work dey sell tickets: first enroll dis phone wit di code wey you receive.

erreurs.telephone: Put your 9-digit number, e dey start wit 6.
erreurs.pin: Put di 6 digits of your PIN.
erreurs.code: Put di 6 digits of di code wey you receive.
erreurs.codeEnrolement: Put di enrollment code wey you receive.
erreurs.identifiants: Number, PIN or password no correct.
erreurs.codeFaux: Dis code no correct or e don expire. Login again make you get another one.
erreurs.bloque: Account don lock because of too many tries. Try again for {{delai}}.
erreurs.tropDemandes: Too many requests. Try again for {{delai}}.
erreurs.reseau: Di server no dey answer. Check your network and try again.
erreurs.enrolementInconnu: Dis code no dey or dem don use am before. Ask for new one.
erreurs.enrolementExpire: Dis code don expire. Ask for new one.
erreurs.sansEspace: Dis account no get space for di app.
erreurs.inattendue: We no fit login now. Try again.
